examples.prompt: Write a story about a character named Daisy.
examples.reply:
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Daisy. Daisy was very excited because she was going to the park with her mom. She was so excited!
When they arrived, Daisy saw a big, red ball. She ran over to it and started to play with it. She kicked it and it went very far.
Daisy's mom said, "Daisy, be careful! That ball is very expensive."
Daisy nodded and said, "I will be careful, Mommy."
Daisy's mom smiled and said, "That's great, Daisy! Now let's go home and have some lunch."
So Daisy and her mom went home and Daisy was very happy. She had a great day at the park and she was so excited to go back again.

examples.reply:
Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play outside in the sun. One day, he saw a small, helpless bird in the grass. The bird could not fly.

Tim opened the window and let the bird go. The bird was very happy. Tim felt good for helping the bird. He went outside and played with his friends all day.

Once upon a time, in a big zoo, there was a zebra named Zara. Zara was a very fast zebra. She loved to run and play with her friends. One day, Zara saw a big, scary bird. The bird was very loud and made Zara feel sad.
Zara wanted to help the bird, so she started to yell very loud. "Go away, bird! You are scary!" Zara yelled back, but the bird did not listen. Zara was still sad and did not know what to do.
Then, something unexpected happened. The bird found out it was not mean after all. It was just trying to fly. The bird helped Zara to fly high and far. Zara was happy and thanked the bird. From that day on, Zara and the bird became best friends, and they played together at the zoo.
